[SWS_CM_80064] Transport protocol for sending of an event message
⌈
The event message shall be transmitted using UDP if the threshold defined by the
multicastThreshold attribute of the SomeipProvidedEventGroup that is aggre-
gated by the ProvidedSomeipServiceInstance in the role eventGroup in the
Manifest has been reached (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00134]).
The event message shall be transmitted using the transport protocol defined by the
attribute SomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment.fieldDeployment.notifier.
transportProtocol in the Manifest if this threshold has not been reached (see
[PRS_SOMEIPSD_00802]).
⌋
